༄༅/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bstod pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba

bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bstod pa bzhugs so/ / na mo dza ya ma hā ma na ye/ mkha' khyab snang ldan gzugs kyis dben pa'i sku| |mtha' med dbyangs sgrog brjod dang bral ba'i gsung/ /ma lus chos gzigs bsam rtogs spangs pa'i thugs/ /rnam 'dren gsang ba bsam mi khyab der 'dud/ /'di na rmongs pa'i bran gyur skye bo 'gas/ /rang la mngon gyur lung rigs phra mo yis/ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mtha' 'jal ba/ /'di dag khron pa'i rus sbal kho nar zad/ /de phyir rgyal sras zhi ba'i blo gros kyis/ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba rnams/ /dris te gsang ba'i bdag pos smras pa'i lan| |ji bzhin bdag kyang khyod la bsngags par 'dod/ khyod sku'i snang ba tshad med de/ /'ga' yis bzhugs mthong de nyid tshe/ /la las bzhengs dang rnal bar mthong*/ /gzhud pa sogs su'ang rtog phyir ro/ /de bzhin gser sbyangs btso ma'i mdog /'ga' la mthon ka mar gad dang*/ /leb rgan chu shel pad rag yang*/ /gnas skabs 'khrul rgyu med par mthong/ /tshangs dbang gnod sbyin gdengs can dang*/ /skyes pa bud med khyi'u sogs/ /gang dang gang la gang dga' ba/ /de dang de la de gzugs ston/ /kun la 'khrul dang ma 'khrul gyi// rnam par dbye ba mi 'thad na/ khyod sku thogs bcas rdul grub tu/ /don la gnas 'dod 'khrul par zad/ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ /sha rus khrag dang nang khrol can/ zhal zas gsol bar gang mthong ba/ /de yang rang rang snang ba lags| |zhal zas lhag mar snang ba yis/ /'gro mang bde la bkod pa tsam// gzhan gyi sgo gsum spyod pas min/ /sha khrag snang ba'ang de bzhin no/ /de ltas khyod sku phung khams dang*/ /skye mched sogs kyis ma phye bar/ /gsal ba gsung na mig dbang sogs/ /bden zhen gyis smra 'di dag nongs/ /yungs 'bru tsam gyi sku yis kyang*/ /nam mkha'i ltos kun khyab gyur cing*/ /de gnyis che chung 'gyur min na/

/che khyad tshad gzung su yis bgyid/ /shugs 'chang zhes byas gaṅgā klung*/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing rgal nas/ /steng phyogs pad mo can du'ang/ gtsug tor ma mthong nongs par gyur/ /nam mkhas ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /skus kyang de snyed kun khyab na/ khyod skus stong pa'i phyogs smra ba/ /'di ni rmongs pa'i mun pas khyab/ /gser gyi ri ltar mkhregs shing brtan/ /ka tsa lin ltar mnyen zhing yang*/ /'di yang tha snyad tshul lugs kyis/ /bsam par nus pa ma lags so| |mdor na khyod kyi tshogs gnyis dang*/ /gdul bya rang rang smon lam las// sku'i bkod pa gang snang ba'i/ /mtha' de khyod kyis kyang mi mkhyen/ /de dag kun kyang mi rtogs tai/ /ji ltar me long dag pa la/ /gzugs kyi rnam pa kun snang yang*| |rnam par mi rtag ji bzhin no/ khyod sku mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar zhing*// lta bas mi ngoms mdzes ldan du/ /smra ba 'dis kyang khyod sku yi/ /gsang ba rtogs snyam mi bgyid do/ /snang bas dben pa'i ye shes sku/ /gang la gang 'dul der snang bas/ /rnam med rnam pa kun ldan du/ /nges don mdo rgyud kun tu gsungs| khyod sku'i gsang ba nam mkha'i dpes/ /rgyal tshab dam pas gang gsung pa/ /'di yang gnyis med gsung khyod kyi/ /bzhed pa'i mchog tu bdag gis khums/ /ci slad zhe na nam mkha' ni/ /kun gyi rjes song spros rtog med// kun gyi nyer 'tsho gzugs kun bzhugs/ /gzugs kun der 'dus ji lta ba// de ltar khyod sku rtogs pa yi/ /spros pa med cing kun rjes so/ /kun phan gzugs can kun la khyab/ /sems can snang kun de 'dus lags/ /des na sha khrag rdos bcas dang*/ /snang med rnam kun mchog ldan dang*/ /spros pa'i mtshan mas dben pa rnams/ /drang nges yang dag nges don lags/ /sems bskyed bsod nams mkhar mi shong*/ /des kyang dam chos 'dzin pa dang*/ /de yis stong nyid la mos pa'i/ /dge la char mi phod pa lags/

khyod kyis 'di gsum kun rdzogs na/ /'di 'dra'i rgyu las de tsam gyi/ /'bras bu 'khrungs la ci zhig mtshar| |des na rgyu la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste le'u dang po'o// //mgon khyod mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /ji srid mya ngan 'das bar du// yi ge gcig kyang ma gsungs te/ /ngag rgyu rtog dpyod bzlog phyir ro/ khyod gsung zhal nas mi 'byung ste/ /byed pa'i rtsol ba spangs phyir ro/ /de slad nam mkha'i khams las byung/ /de yis gdul bya'i bsam rdzogs byed/ /bka' yi khyod gsung zhal dang ni/ /la las gtsug tor mdzod spu sogs/ /gzhan dang gzhan las byung bar mthong*/ kun kyang 'khrul dang ma 'khrul mtshungs/ /de slad khyod gsung bskrun pa'i rgyu/ /bsam rtog yod par 'dod pa dang*/ /khyod zhal kho nas 'byung ba'i sgor/ /smra ba 'di dag 'khrul par zad/ khyod gsung ngag du snang ba yang*/ /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs rnams kyis/ /rnam par spras phyir ngag gzhan kun/ /nyi ma me khyer ji bzhin no/ /mnyen 'jam yid 'ong yid 'thad dag |dri med 'od gsal snyan cing 'jebs/ /mnyan 'os mi tshugs snyan dang dul| |mi rtsub mi brlang rab tu dul/ /rnar snyan lus sim sems tshim byed// snying dga' byed dang dga' bde bskyed/ /gdung med kun shes rnam rig bya// rnam gsal dga' byed mngon dga' byed/ /shes byed rig byed rigs dang 'brel| |mi bzlos seng ga glang chen 'brug /klu dang dri za ka la ping*/ /tshangs dang shang shang te'u dang/ /lha dbang rnams kyi dbyangs ltar grags/ /rnga sgra mi khengs mi dma' dang*/ /sgra kun rjes song zur chag med*/ /ma tshang med dang ma zhum dang*/ /mi zhan rab dga' khyab dang chub/ /rgyun chags 'phel dngasgra kun rdzogs| |dbang po thams cad tshim byed dang*/ /ma smad mi 'gyur ma stabs dang*| |'khor kun grags dang dug gsum sel*/

/bdud rnams 'joms dang mchog ldan rnams/ /yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi yon tan lags| |gsung gi phyogs bcu kun 'gengs shing*/ /sems can bsam kun rdzogs byed kyang*/ /bsam rtog cung zad mi mnga' ba/ /e ma khyod gsung bsam mi khyab/ /sems can spyod la tshad med de/ /spyod pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du// gsungs pa'ang blo zhan rjes bzung phyir/ /tshad ldan lta bur bstan par zad// tshad med sems can spyod pa dang*/ /mthun par dus gcig kho na la/ /de snyed dam chos ston mdzad kyang*/ khyod gsung zad par rngo mi thogs/ /rol mo mkhan gyi sil snyan sgra/ /rtog med rlung gis sgra kun 'byung*/ /de bzhin khyod gsung dbyangs kun sgrog /brag cha'-i dpes kyang mchog tu bsngags/ /nam mkhas ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ khyod gsung gis kyang khyab lags na/ khyod kyi gsung gi mtha' 'jal ba/ /rmongs pas kha lo bsgyur bar zad/ /mo 'gal bu yis gaṅgā klung*| |dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i zhing rgal nas/ /nub phyogs 'od zer can zhing du'ang*/ /gsung mtha' ma rtogs nongs par 'gyur/ /'gro kun shā ri'i bu lta bu'i/ /thogs med spobs pa can gyur nas/ /dus gcig the tshom don dris nas| |lan gyis gcig char tshim par mdzad/ /'gro ba kun gyi sgra skad kyi/ /tha snyad thugs mtha' med na yang*/ /so so'i skad kyi rang rang dang*/ /mthun pa'i gsung dbyangs mtha' med pas/ /rang rang bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /rtogs nas phan bde'i dpal 'byung ba/ khyod gsung gsang ba'i zab khyad de/ /mkhas rlom skye bos 'ol mi mchi/ /gsung gi 'gro la phan pa tsam/ /sku yis phan par ga la nus| |de slad sku yi sgrub byed kun/ /bsdoms kyang gsung gcig 'grub ma lags| khyod gsung rang mtshan sgra skad dang*/ /longs sku rnam pa kun ldan dang*| |spros pa nyer zhi'i chos dbyings rnams/ /drang nges mthar thug nges don lags| |yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/

gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// // khyod thugs spros pa nyer zhi bas/ /rtog dpyod mtho dma' khro chags dang*/ /zhi lhag yul dang yul can sogs/ /rnam pa kun tu gtan ma mchis/ /dus gsum sogs la mi rtog cing*/ /'dus byas sogs la mi gnas la/ /rtag tu mnyam par bzhag bzhin du/ /'bad med lhun grub 'phrin las 'byung*/ /shes bya mtha' dag dus gcig gsal/ /snang ba'i mtshan ma'ang rtag tu spangs/ /thugs rjes 'gro la nam yang gzigs/ /khyod thugs gsang ba'i zab khyad lags/ /de lta'i sku dang gsung mchog la/ /rten cing rnam pa du ma yis/ /de gnyis las kyang lhag pas na/ khyod thugs gsang ba mdor bsdus te/ /rten gyi yon tan phun tshogs dang*/ /brten pa'i yon tan phan tshun du| |'tsham par bgyid pa 'jig rten gyi/ /tshul lugs la yang legs par gda'/ /de lta mod kyi 'jig rten gyi/ /tha snyad tshul gyis mgon khyod kyi// gsang ba zab mor dpyod pa ni/ /dpa' khyod bzhed par ma lags te/ /'jig rten kun dang mi mthun pas/ khyod kyi gzhung lugs mchog nyid du/ khyod dang khyod sras dge rnams kyis/ /lan gcig min par gsungs pas so/ /de slad res 'ga' rnal ba dang*/ /'jig rten spyod la 'jug pa dang*/ /yul gzhan 'jal bar snang ba yang*/ /des 'dul skye bo'i rang snang lags/ /tha mal dka' thub kyis gdung dang*/ /sprul sku mkha' khyab ting 'dzin bzhugs/ /ye shes sku yis mthar son rnams/ /snang mkhan gdul bya'i khyad par te/ /de bzhin bdud kyi gtses pa dang*/ /bdud med byang chub mnyes pa dang*/ /gdod nas bdud las rgyal ba rnams/ /mkhas pa gong nas gong du mthar/ /de phyir mdzad pa bcu gnyis kun/ /gdul bya 'dul phyir de dang der/ /snang tshul bstan par gsungs pa rnams/ /mkhas pa'i yid la cis mi 'bab/ khyod kyi yon tan ji snyed kun/ khyod thugs kho nas bskrun pa ste/ khyod kyi dge legs ji snyed pa'ang/

/yul gyi gnas lugs gzigs pas so/ /de slad khyod gsung chos phung kun/ /gnas skabs gdul bya'i ngor byas kyang*/ /mthar thug gnas skabs rtogs ched de// skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsung phyir/ /khyod kyi mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /bla na blo gzhan ma mchis la/ /de yis gzigs pa'i chos dbyings kyi/ /gong na yul gzhan ma mchis so/ /tshul 'di ston pa'i gzhung lugs ni/ /bstan pa'i mchog tu grub pas na/ /mgon khyod ston pa zla med du/ /rkang gi khongs nas cis mi mdzin| |ci slad yul gyi gnas tshul dang*/ /blo yi 'dzin stangs mi mthun pas// 'gro 'di 'khor ba'i btson rar ni/ /sdug bsngal kho na'i gzhan dbang gyur/ skyon de gnas lugs mthong ba las/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyi mi sel zhing*// thabs de khyod kyis legs mkhyen nas/ /bstan cing gzhan gyis min pas so// des na mnyam rjes res 'jog dang*/ /mnyam gzhag gnyis snang nub pa dang*// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rnams/ /drang nges mthar thug nges don lags// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// //de ltar 'dren pa mchog de'i gsang ba rnams/ /rgyal sras dpa' bos mngon sum mi dmigs na/ /blo zhan bdag gis blo gros bskyod pa ni/ /bye'us mkha' mtha' 'jal dang cis mi mtshungs/ /'on kyang nyi ma'i snang ba shar ba na// mig ldan gzugs la blta ba ji bzhin du/ /rnam 'dren nyid kyi gsung gi snang ba la| |brten nas dad pa'i rba rlabs g.yos pa yin/ /tshul 'di ston de'i rjes zhugs stag tshang pa/ /mang thos bsgrub la sbyar 'dod skad gnyis pa/ /tshangs spyod mchog gnas pra dzñā'i ming can gyis/ /rnam 'dren mchog de'i yon tan mthong nas smras/ /gang zhig bsam na dad pa'i spu ldang zhing*/ /mig gi bkod ma dbyar dus ji bzhin du/ /bgyid pa'i ston dang bstan pas yid phrogs nas// ston de'i bka' drin bsob pas brel gyur cig

/bdag ni sgo gsum yang na g.yo ma gyur/ /g.yo na bstan pa'i snying po thabs gang gis/ /yun du rgyas ched kho nas nyid mtshan dang*/ /lang tsho 'da' bar byed pa nyid gyur cig /de las rgyal ba'i dam chos lung rtogs rnams/ /slar yang shar gyi sa 'dzin rtse mor ni/ /'od stong 'bar ba lta bur rab gsal zhing*/ /phan bde'i snang bas phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang tshul mdor bsdus brjod pa 'dis kyang phan bde'i dpal gyis sa steng khyab par gyur cig/ // dge'o/ / mod der gsang bdag gis ston pa la bstod pa ni/ chos kyi dbang phyug rgya chen mi zad chos kyi mdzod/ /chos rnams rab tu 'byed la mkhas pa 'gro don bzhed/ / chos la thugs ma zhum zhing rtag tu lhag par mthong*/ /chos kyi rjes mthun chos sgrub gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can dag pas khyod kyi ye shes spyod rnam dag /yon tan rgyal grags snyan pa 'jig rten gsum du grags/ /ye shes rgyun ni dus gsum rtag tu bas ma 'tshal| |chags 'das zhabs mnyam legs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba las lhag yongs dag tshul khrims rnam par dag /nyi ma las lhag 'od mdzes 'od mnga' gzi brjid mchog /tshangs pa las lhag gsung snyan tshangs pa'i gsung mnga' ba/ /dkon mchog gsum ldan gser 'dra khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod ni sku yang ston la sku dang ldan ma lags/ khyod ni gsung yang brjod la sgra skad rtog mi mnga'/ khyod ni chos kyang gsung la chos kyi 'du shes bral/ /sems can thar mdzad chos kyi 'du shes bral la 'dud/ /gang dag khyod bstan thos nas ji ltar bstan pa ltar/ /sgrub la snying por gnas pa rnams ni ma gtogs par| |'gro ba thams cad rtag tu rab tu byung yang ni/ /khyod kyi bka' drin lan ldon nam yang rngo mi thogs/ /ces pa'i tshigs bcad tha ma 'di'i rkang pa phyi ma gnyis dang por brjod nas/

de bas khyod bstan thos nas ji ltar bstan pa ltar| |sgrub la snying po byed pas bka' drin ldon gyur cig/ 'dir gsang bdag gi rnam thar mdor bsdu na/ gang gi skal bzang sems dpa' stong dang de rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas tshe na'ang de dag re re'i phyi bzhin du/ /rdo rje thogs pa'i gnod sbyin chen po'i cha byad kyis/ /'brang zhing de kun bstan bsrungs gsang bdag la phyag 'tshal/ /skal bzang 'di dang mi 'khrugs mdzad pa'i mthar// rnam par sbyong la yongs dag 'jig rten du/ /rdo rje rnam par gnon pa'i rgyal ba ni| |'tshang rgyar 'gyur ba'i phyag rdor khyod la 'dud/ /ces bya'o zhes kyang dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis sbyaraba'o// //maṅgalaṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa la bstod pa/ -PAGE 152--PAGE 153-- PAGE 145-
